"...I can't believe this... This kind of 
result..."

text_block_list.text:
El suffered an unexpected pinfall 
loss-desu...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The world's strongest Umamusume couldn't 
even step into the leader's shadow!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
choice_data_list: Next time, let's win by a landslide.

text_block_list.text:
...You really believe in me, don't you, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
For El to win, and be the world's 
strongest Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...All right, no time to sit around 
moping!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I promise you! Next time, an 
overwhelming victory! And I'll carry you 
on my shoulders, yeeees!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Is it... the usual pace, YES...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, I'm just gonna go for a quick 
run outside, okay?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El just needs a widdle bit of time to get 
back to being El-desu.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Once I'm back... I'll be counting on you 
for the world's greatest training, yeeees!
